what_this_is: The founder's rulings over PTF-TOLEDO-OH-NEW-MARKET-001's grouped packet, transcribed verbatim. It is kept apart from the packet because the packet is regenerated by an idempotent builder and a ruling must not live where a rebuild can erase it.
who_decided_and_who_typed: decided_by is the founder, who ruled in session. recorded_by is the agent that transcribed the ruling. Nothing here was inferred, defaulted or completed by the agent, and no approval field carries a human name the human did not put there.

rulings.founder_words: Revise the prior Bowling Green ruling. INCLUDE the three Bowling Green identities in the Toledo market for this promotion. Treat Bowling Green as the Toledo market's southern / Bowling Green corridor. Preserve their existing evidence and classifications. Do not create a second overlapping Bowling Green market while these identities belong to Toledo unless a later founder-authorized market split explicitly migrates them.
rulings.the_evidence_the_founder_weighed_the_oth: Bowling Green is inside the Toledo, OH Metropolitan Statistical Area (Wood County); Marriott issues its Fairfield the code TOLBG, Marriott's own Toledo prefix; and Hilton lists the Hampton and the Home2 on Toledo-area city pages. Against that the agent weighed 22 miles of distance and a university town's own demand. The founder weighed the brands' own treatment of it as Toledo inventory as the stronger signal.

what_it_changes.corridor: toledo-oh__bowling-green is REGISTERED as authored. It is not widened: it claims ZIP 43402 alone and reaches no further into Wood County.

what_it_changes.the_precedent_test: An existing signed precedent is 'fully deterministic' only when a prior order's SIGNED ruling settles this exact disposition on facts this market already holds. A precedent that merely resembles the case does not qualify, and the promotion order may not stretch one to admit a row.

rulings.founder_words: Proceed at 9 verified no-pets. Do NOT publish either policy read under the current merged identity. Hold both. The current address_key collapses the building letter and therefore cannot safely distinguish the two Wyndham identities. Publishing either policy under the merged identity risks assigning opposite pet policies to one canonical row. Do not invent a split inside this promotion order.

rulings.preserve: Both first-party captures and all identity evidence are preserved: the reads stay in toledo_oh_evidence_audit_001.json with their quotes, document provenance and identity signals, and the census row keeps every alias that names either brand.

a_conflict_the_agent_must_not_resolve_si.what: Two conflicts arose and both were surfaced rather than reconciled. The first was Bowling Green (resolved by TOLEDO-R1A). The second was a one-row difference between the founder's restated 10 verified no-pets and the 9 that correct application of TOLEDO-R2 produces, caused by a defect in the agent's own wrong-evidence audit.
a_conflict_the_agent_must_not_resolve_si.why_it_was_worth_asking: the first differed by three published pages; the second would have put a 'no other pets' fact and a 'Dog-friendly' fact on one canonical row. No technical gate catches either.
